content:
**LESSON (external ruling rev 3, #297): a LOCAL MIRROR of a frozen pin must be judged on its DRIFT DIRECTION, and the direction for a dedup/grouping key is the opposite of the intuitive one.**

**What happened**: `brain-audit.mjs`'s `payloadSignature` (`SIG_CONFIG`/`SIG_ARGS`) re-declares the pinned diff command that `resolution.mjs` keeps module-private as `normDiff`, because the newest-carrier `[FAIL-SHA]` dedup needs a per-merge payload signature and the exported primitives return net INTEGERS only. The mirror shipped with a safety note claiming that drifting COARSER yields at worst an EXTRA `[FAIL-SHA]` — "the pre-dedup fail-safe behavior".

**That claim is INVERTED, and it survived two review passes.** Coarser means more dedup-key COLLISIONS. Two distinct payloads land on one key, so the second payload's `[FAIL-SHA]` is SUPPRESSED — a MISSED emission, fail-open for PR4's consumer, not an extra one. `crossCheckExit` compares booleans (`count > 0`), so it can never detect a partial suppression.

**Root cause**: a mirror gets judged on whether it is CURRENTLY correct (it was byte-identical, no live exploit) instead of on what happens when it drifts. Deduplication inverts the naive intuition: for a FILTER, coarser lets more through; for a GROUPING KEY, coarser lets LESS through, because collisions collapse distinct items into one. Reviewers pattern-match "coarser = more noise = safe" and skip deriving the direction.

**Second-order cause**: the freeze that motivated the copy also suppresses the obvious fix. "Export the helper" reopens a frozen surface — a decision above the implementer's authority — so the local copy looks like the humble choice when it actually moves risk somewhere nobody is watching. (Rev 6 later CORRECTED this premise: the PR2b freeze covers only `isReverterOf`'s own export surface, not the whole module — so the signature-export path was never doctrinally blocked, and mirror-vs-export is pure design whenever it is revisited.)

**The fence, shipped**: a source-scan drift-guard test asserting `SIG_CONFIG`/`SIG_ARGS` stay VALUE-aligned (not format-aligned — a guard that reddens on a line break is a guard nobody keeps) with `resolution.mjs`'s `HARDENED_CONFIG`/`DIFF_ARGS`, plus a second assertion that the mirror strips the same position-only lines. Forged before being trusted: dropping `--binary` from the mirror reddens it.

**Rules that generalize**: (1) derive the failure direction, never assert it; (2) fence a mirror with a drift-guard you have SEEN go red; (3) route the single-source-of-truth fix to whoever owns the freeze instead of absorbing it into a comment that says "out of scope".

**Promotion candidate** (ADR-0013 draft-and-promote): the long-form anti-pattern draft lives at `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/brain-drafts/local-mirror-of-a-frozen-pin.md`, awaiting the owner's promotion into `brain/core/anti-patterns/`.
